RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the April 22, 2008/Vaisakha 2, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
127
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Threat of global warming
*401. SHRI T.T.V . DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether India has geared up to meet
acute water shortage in view of the threat
of global warming;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Capital with FFIs
†*402. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETH-
MALANI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that capital of
Foreign Financial Institutions (FFIs) during
the year 2007-08 has constantly increased
upto December, 2007;
(b) if so, the amount of capital brought
in India by these FFIs between April to
June, July to September and October to
December, 2007;
(c) whether it is also a fact that foreign
capital has been collected by respective
institutions during each of the said period;
and
(d) if so, the amount of capital collected
by them during each of the said period?
Rise in inflation rate
*403. SHRI RAMDAS
AGARWAL:
SHRI DARA SINGH:
 Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has been able
to check the inflation rate which has touched
a 59-week high of 6.7 per cent as on
15 March, 2008 and inflation is likely to
remain at elevated levels between 6.7 per
cent and 7.4 per cent;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years on quarterly basis till date;
(c) whether Reserve Bank of India has
apprehended any upward pressure of
inflation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken by Government, till date in this regard

128
keeping in view that wholesale price-based
inflation rate has already jumped 1.5
percentage points through first fortnight
of March, 2008?
Funds for the weaker sections
*404. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA
SULE:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI :
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has announced
that it would set up two funds with a total
corpus of Rs. 1,000 crore for greater
financial inclusion of weaker sections of
the society through development work,
each with a corpus of Rs. 500 crore, of
which a maximum of Rs. 200 crore each
would be contributed by the Centre over a
period of five years;
(b) whether during 2007-08, he had
announced constitution of Financial
Inclusion Fund and Financial Inclusion
Technology Fund with an overall corpus
of Rs. 500 crore each with initial funding
from Government, RBI and the NABARD;
and
(c) the extent to which the funds had
been utilised so far?
Involvement of  airlines in human
trafficking
*405. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Directorate General of
Civil Aviation (DGCA) is aware that staff
of various airlines are involved in human
trafficking;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
put a check on the activities of staff of
various airlines posted at airports/planes;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Fresh guidelines for recruitment of
loan recovery agents
*406. SHRI MAHENDRA
MOHAN:
DR. (SHRIMATI) NAJMA
A. HEPTULLA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether RBI has issued fresh
guidelines to be followed by the private
banks for recruitment of loan recovery
agents;
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
whether these guidelines are drafted in
consultation with the private banks;
(c) how the antecedents of recovery
agents are being verified by the Banks;
(d) what role the State police plays in
this regard; and
(e) how the fresh guidelines are different
from the old guidelines?
Post office savings scheme
*407. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently the
withdrawals from the various post office
savings scheme are more than the deposits,
leading to a negative growth;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) what is Government's reaction
thereto?

129
Financial restructuring of BHPV
*408. SHRI TA PAN KUMAR
SEN:
SHRI MOHAMMED
AMIN:
 Will the Minister of HEA VY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether a press release from the
Cabinet on financial restructuring of Bharat
Heavy Plates and V essels Ltd. (BHPV) was
uploaded in the PIB website on
26 November, 2007 at 2149 hrs.;
(b) if so, whether the press release
conveyed Government's approval to
proposals, viz. waiver and write off of loans
and interest amounting to Rs. 414.95 crores
upto 31 March, 2007 and settlement of all
outstanding liabilities of BHPV amounting
to Rs. 263.97 crores;
(c) whether the press release was
withdrawn from the PIB website
immediately after uploading;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) whether the aforesaid Government's
approval has undergone any change?
Electronic medium of banking
*409. SHRI TARIQ ANW AR: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to encourage use of electronic
medium for banking;
(b) if so, the details of the facilities
provided by the banks;
(c) whether all the facilities available in
the urban areas are provided in the rural
areas too;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(e) what are the steps Government is
taking to provide those facilities in rural
areas also?
Production of Natural Gas in KG
Basin
*410. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to refer to
answer to Unstarred Question 571 given in
the Rajya Sabha on 4 March, 2008 and
state:
(a) whether ONGC has plans to begin
production of Natural Gas from the Kaveri-
Godavari (KG) Basin; and
(b) if so, by when the production would
begin, alongwith the details of the expected
quantity of natural gas to be produced by
ONGC, year-wise?
Hotel Management Institutes
*411. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
TOURISM  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Government run
Institutes of Hotel Management and
Institutes of Food Craft, State-wise;
(b) whether Government has any plan
to set up an Institute of Hotel Management
and an Institute of Food Craft in Himachal
Pradesh;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Closure/revival of Public Sector
Enterprises
*412. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of HEA VY INDUSTRIES AND
PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of Public Sector
Enterprises existing and closed when the
U.P.A. Government took over;

130
(b) how many new Public Sector
Enterprises came into being during the
tenure of the U.P.A. Government and how
many sick units were revived and restored;
(c) how many have been closed during
the tenure of the U.P.A. Government as on
28 February, 2008;
(d) whether the progress of revival and
rehabilitation is very slow;
(e) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(f) the extra effective measures taken
for revival of the closed industries?
Extension of AIBP in the country
†*413. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Accelerated
Irrigation Benefit Programme (AIBP) was
started during the last decade to bring rapid
extension of irrigation system in the
country;
(b) if so, when the above programme
was started and what were the objectives
thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that following
introduction of the said programme, the
irrigation system in the country has
expanded; and
(d) if so, consequent upon introduction
of this programme the average annual
creation of irrigated land in the country
during the intervening years upto March,
2007?
Agricultural land under Wealth Tax
*414. SHRI NARESH GUJRAL: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agricultural
land, which is being used for agricultural
purposes but falls under the Municipal
limits/ jurisdiction, is subject to Wealth Tax;
and
(b) if so, whether Government is
thinking of exempting it from Wealth Tax?
Paradeep Oil Refinery
*415. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NA TURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) the time-frame to complete Paradeep
Oil Refinery of Indian Oil Corporation; and
(b) the total Budget and money spent
on the project till date?
Disinvestment in Public Sector
Enterprises
*416. SHRI SU. THIRUNA VUK-
KARASAR: Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Public Sector
Enterprises which are earning profit;
(b) the steps taken to improve their
performance to earn profit, if any of these
concerns is in loss;
(c) whether the disinvestment scheme
is being implemented; and
(d) if so, the details of such units and
the stages of their disinvestment?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

131
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 16th April, 2008 Secretary-General.
Chaitra 27, 1930 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Gosikhurd Dam
†*417. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will
the Minister of W ATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Maharashtra has requested
the Centre to recognize the Gosikhurd Dam
in Bhandara district in drought affected
Vidarbha as a national plan;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Central Government
proposes to recognize it as a national plan;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Sanction of big dam projects
†*418. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI RUDRA NARAY AN
PANY:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) the role of the Central Government
in sanctioning big dam projects;
(b) whether Government would take
Suo motu decision on other places in the
light of decision of Madhya Pradesh High
Court for providing land to the people
affected by these projects;
(c) whether due to lack of constant flow
of water, people residing ahead of dams are
facing difficulties; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Losses of Indian Airlines
*419. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines has suffered
huge financial losses during the last three
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Indian Airlines operates
maximum 55 flights daily from Delhi
whereas nearly 300 Pilots/Co-Pilots are
stationed here;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether it is a fact that excess of
Pilots/Co-Pilots is also a factor behind the
losses of Indian Airlines; and
(f) if so, the details thereof and the
corrective steps taken in this regard?
Sovereign investment
fund
*420. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
to set up a sovereign investment fund with
an initial corpus of $5 billion to acquire
companies abroad;
(b) if so, whether this fund will also be
used for bolstering country's energy
security by acquiring coal, mines and oil
blocks abroad;
(c) if so, whether the Prime Minister
has already issued directives to the
Ministry in this regard; and
(d) if so, by what time Government is
likely to announce the decision?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Civil Aviation : 405, 419,
Corporate Affairs :—
Culture :—

Heavy Industries and Public
Enterprises : 408, 412, 416,
Petroleum and Natural Gas : 410, 415,
Tourism : 411,
Water Resources : 401, 413, 417, 418.
